subject: Copywriting
title: Mary Wells Lawrence: First Female CEO
description: Learn Mary Wells Lawrence: First Female CEO in one minute.

hook.text: Mary Wells painted Braniff International's planes pastel colors and dressed flight attendants in Pucci.

buildup.text: In 1966, she founded Wells Rich Greene and became the first woman to head a company on the New York Stock Exchange.

discovery.text: Her 'I Love New York' campaign saved the city's tourism. Created in 1977, the logo and slogan endure today.

twist.text: She was the highest-paid executive in advertising—not the highest-paid woman, the highest-paid person.

climax.text: Wells Lawrence proved that big creative ideas could come from women in an era that tried to say otherwise.

punchline.text: She painted planes and saved New York. Creativity has no ceiling.
